meta_data.base_class: Gain insights from user data interactions on a <specific social platform> service account. - applicable for querying various social or messaging platforms that require an authentication token and operate within a specific analysis period.

tool_template.name: UserDataInsights_<class>
tool_template.description: Gain insights from user data interactions on a <class> service account.

auth_token.description: The authentication token for accessing <class> data.

analysis_period.description: The period for analysis, specified as 'last_week', 'last_month', or 'last_year'.

data_type.description: Type of user data to analyze in the <class> account, one of 'text', 'image', or 'video'.

interaction_threshold.description: Minimum number of interactions required for a user data point in the <class> account to be considered significant. Should be a non-negative integer.

timezone.description: The timezone to use for aligning interaction timestamps in the <class> account.

language.description: Language of the user data interactions to focus on in the <class> account, such as 'en' for English or 'es' for Spanish.
